result.topic_en: The page notes that proof by mathematical induction goes back to Jacob Bernoulli, then converts the series 1 − ax + abx² − abcx³ … into a continued fraction, with the factorial series 1 − x + 2x² − 6x³ + 24x⁴ … as an example, and refers to a theorem of Euler.
